No. 2105/28– WEDNESDAY, JANUARY, 09, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice Under Section 7 My No.: YAK/LAN/01/03/05. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/8/2014/PC/274. I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: The allotments of Land in total extent of 0.0038 Hectares depicted as lot No. 1310, 1311, 1312 in sheet No. 32, Additional No. 29, of F. V. P. No. 641 made by Surveyor General situated in the Village of Beranagoda in the Grama Niladhari Division of 177D, Yakkalamulla East, in the Divisional Secretariat Yakkalamulla Thalpe Paththuwa North, District of Galle, Southern Province. The names and extents of the allotments of land are as follows:
Lot No. 1310 Name of the Land: Kajjugaha Liyadda, Jambugaha Liyadda; Land Use; Paddy field and Road (Section);Claimant: Ranjith Dias, Indigahagodalla, Yakkalamulla; Extent : 0.0033 Hectare.
Lot No. 1311 Name of the Land: Kajjugaha Liyadda, Jambugaha Liyadda; Land Use; Paddy field and Road (Section);Claimant: Ranjith Dias, Indigahagodalla, Yakkalamulla; Extent : 0.0003 Hectare.
Lot No. 1312 Name of the Land: Kajjugaha Liyadda, Jambugaha Liyadda; Land Use; Paddy field; Claimant: Ranjith Dias, Indigahagodalla, Yakkalamulla; Extent: 0.0002 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/Lands* on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Yakkalamulla the 13th day of February 2019 at 10.00 o clock and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 06th day of February 2019 the nature of their interests in the land the particulars of their claims of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
CHANDIMA C. MUHANDIRAMGE, Divisional Secretary, Divisional Secretariat, Yakkalamulla.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Yakkalamulla, 04th January, 2019. 01-585
